WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE DIRECTOR
(SMC·PRIVATE) LIMITED ("COMPANY")

OF OLX CLASSIFIEDS

PAKISTAN

IT IS NOTED THAT:
The Board of Directors of OLX Middle East Holdings BV. ("Single Member") of the Company
has resolved to de-nominate Mr. Farhan Khan from acting as the Single Member's nominee
director of the Company. The Board of Directors of the Single Member has further resolved that
in place of Mr. Farhan Khan, Mr. Umair Munir is nominated as the Single Member's nominee
director of the Company. Mr. Umair Munir has also consented to his appointment as the aforesaid.
In addition to the above, Mr. Farhan Khan has also resigned from the post of Chief
Executive Officer of the Company. The name of Mr. Umair Munir is proposed to be appointed as
the new Chief Executive Officer of the Company in place of the resigning Chief Executive Officer.
In respect of the above, following resolutions were passed/approved:
RESOLVED:
Resolved that Mr. Umair Munir nominated director of the Single Member, be and is hereby
appointed as the director of the Company, in place of the de-nominated director Mr. Farhan Khan
with immediate effect.
Resolved that the resignation of Mr. Umair Munir be and is hereby accepted and Mr
Farhan Khan will cease to be the Chief Executive Officer of the Company with immediate effect.
Resolved that Mr. Umair Munir be and is hereby appointed as the Chief Executive Officer
of the Company in place of the resigning Chief Executive Officer with immediate effect.
Resolved that Mr. Umair Munir director of the Company be and is hereby authorized to
file requisite returns, including Form-29, with the Registrar of the Companies, Lahore and to
comply with all legal requirements in this regard.
